utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Ira, are we still on for the repair drive? I can help set things up if you need.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, we’re still on for it. I’d appreciate the help setting things up when you can.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll come by and help set up. What time do you want me there?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah — I can lend a hand with the repair drive. What tools do you need?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks, Gus. I’m a little scattered today, but I think I need a wrench and maybe a screwdriver.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem — I’ve got both. I can swing by with a wrench and a screwdriver for you.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a nice turnout already — people have been dropping off tools and a few volunteers signed up too. If you want, I can tell you what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s good to hear, but I’m still a little worried about the logistics. What do they still need?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: They still need a few more hands for sorting and pickup, plus some tape, boxes, and a ladder if anyone can lend one. I can ask around for the bigger items if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing—I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam—could you tell me where you’ll be picking up the supplies and what time you can get there?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can pick up the supplies at the hardware store on Maple, and I can get there around 9 a.m.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m glad you’re in the loop—there’s a repair drive going on, and I’ve been telling folks to stop by if they can help. Want me to send you the details?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, please send them. I’ll take a look and see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the details your way right now. Thanks for being willing to help!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Leo, I’m putting the repair drive details in order now. If you’ve got any items to add, send them my way and I’ll include them.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll check and send you anything I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo — appreciate it. I’ll keep everything updated and let you know if I need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m checking the details first—what needs repairing, and what time is the drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I usually end up joining late, but I can still help with whatever needs fixing. What time are you thinking for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane—let’s plan for a late start then. What time works best for you, and I’ll match the repair list to that?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school pickup times, Mara—what does the repair drive need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be a huge help, Faye—if you can share the pickup windows, I’ll match volunteers around them. I’m also gathering a few tools and folks for quick fixes, so your timing notes will make this much smoother.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll send you the pickup windows this afternoon and flag any tight days. If you need anything else for the repair drive, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s getting organized, but I’m still catching up on the details. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s coming together nicely — folks are sorting volunteers, tools, and the priority fixes now. If you want, I can fill you in on what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please — I’m still a bit behind, so a quick rundown on what’s still needed would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure thing — I’m in. Just point me to the repair drive details and I’ll do my part.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, but can you confirm you’re actually able to help? I just need to know before I send you the details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can help — send me the details and I’ll take care of my part.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m glad to hear the repair drive is underway. If you need a hand, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks Rey — I might take you up on that. I’m a bit all over the place, so a helping hand would be real nice.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — I’m happy to help. Just tell me where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll let the neighbors know about the repair drive and keep the plan moving.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks Vik — I’ll keep an eye on the supplies and set aside anything we’ll need.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, I’ll spread the word and make sure everyone knows what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate that. I’ll do the same from my side.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll check in if I hear any repair drive updates while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I meant to bring that up. I can help out, just tell me what you need from me.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren — I’ll circle back with the details and let you know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Vik — just ping me when you have the list. I’ll do my best not to forget this time.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I think I can help, if I don’t forget again.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great—just bring whatever you can by later today.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I’ll try to bring something by later today.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I’ve got a few tools I can lend for the repair drive. Tell me what you need, and I’ll see if I have it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. A clear list would help — I’m mainly looking for a hammer, a tape measure, and maybe a screwdriver set.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got all three you can borrow. I’ll set them aside for you and bring them over shortly.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what needs doing first?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, thank you, Mara! First up, I’m making a quick list of the homes and repairs, then I’ll send out the sign-up details.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good—I can help check the list once you’ve got it together.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help pull folks together for the repair drive—just let me know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — I’ll keep a running list of who needs what and where to drop things off. I’ll let you know the details as soon as I’ve got them sorted.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll be ready to spread the word once you send the details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m putting together the repair drive list now, Cleo—if you’ve got any homes that need help, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got one: the Millers’ porch light has been out for a week, and they could use a hand with it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo—I’ll add the Millers’ porch light to the list and see who can take it on.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there’s a repair drive happening soon—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m still checking the details, but I can find out the date and what they’re collecting.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d be great—I’m mostly hearing bits and pieces, so I’d love the date and what they need.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m happy to help, but I need the repair drive details first — what needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo — we need help with a few things at the repair drive: some loose chairs, a leaky sink, and a broken gate latch. I can send the schedule and address if you’re still able to help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can help with that. Send me the schedule and address, and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re really up for helping with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely—I’m in. Tell me what you need me to do.
